purpose: Map Docker-contained Leeway architecture coherence, decide missing layer treatment, separate active execution candidates from backups/rollback containers, and keep execution blocked until readiness gaps are closed.

layer_authority_decisions.reason: LeeWay-Standards is the law root. It does not need to run as a container before execution, but every Docker-contained runtime must reference and obey it.
layer_authority_decisions.required_action: Bind all Docker-contained runtime layers to Standards metadata and receipts.

layer_authority_decisions.reason: Discovery is needed to resolve what services, routes, capabilities, health endpoints, and proofs are available inside the Docker-contained runtime scope.
layer_authority_decisions.required_action: Create a no-execute discovery contract or prove discovery is merged into runtime_fabric/api_gateway before execution.

layer_authority_decisions.reason: Runtime Fabric is present in Docker and is the enforcement authority for the Docker-contained scope.
layer_authority_decisions.required_action: Map Runtime Fabric containers to Standards authority and execution gates.

layer_authority_decisions.reason: Agent Lee/Cerebral is present across Docker containers but must be narrowed to active execution lanes.
layer_authority_decisions.required_action: Separate active Agent Lee lanes from backups, rollback containers, and unused lanes.

layer_authority_decisions.reason: Device Layer is present and high-risk. It must remain locked until single-use approval.
layer_authority_decisions.required_action: Map device operator and rollback containers; keep control blocked.

layer_authority_decisions.reason: Voice is present and should become one of the first safe execution proofs after gates.
layer_authority_decisions.required_action: Map Qwen voice, ears kernel, and voice kernel endpoints without executing them.

layer_authority_decisions.reason: Vision/image containers exist and need proof-safe route mapping.
layer_authority_decisions.required_action: Map image/vision lanes and separate generation from Telegram posting.

layer_authority_decisions.reason: Telegram can post externally, so it must be test-channel-only until explicit approval.
layer_authority_decisions.required_action: Map active Telegram shell versus backups; forbid public posting until proof gate.

layer_authority_decisions.reason: Browser runtime can touch web surfaces and must be route-limited.
layer_authority_decisions.required_action: Map browser endpoints and hold off control until approved.

layer_authority_decisions.reason: Model/provider lanes are present; model execution must stay blocked until proof gate.
layer_authority_decisions.required_action: Map Ollama/Qwen/image lanes and model boundaries.

layer_authority_decisions.reason: Memory/data state is present and must be protected before writes.
layer_authority_decisions.required_action: Map volumes, mounts, databases, memory stores, and write boundaries.

layer_authority_decisions.reason: App surfaces expose runtime functions and need route mapping.
Security is weakly detected and likely underclassified.
layer_authority_decisions.required_action: Confirm whether security policy exists as true runtime control or only database labeling.

layer_authority_decisions.reason: Worker lanes can execute tasks and must remain gated.
layer_authority_decisions.required_action: Map worker center and ingestion lanes.

active_vs_inactive_policy.condition: state is running and not named backup or rollback
compose project is not leeway-ecosystemv214 or blank Leeway-owned runtime

coherence_gaps.description: Discovery layer is not present in Docker and must be explicitly added or proven merged into an existing Docker runtime authority before execution.
coherence_gaps.recommended_next: 435 should decide whether discovery is merged into runtime_fabric/api_gateway or requires a dedicated discovery contract.

coherence_gaps.description: Some containers are high-risk or require manual review before execution.
coherence_gaps.recommended_next: 435 must review high-risk containers and produce safe execution order.

coherence_gaps.description: Rollback and backup containers exist and must be excluded from active execution scope unless explicitly reactivated.

coherence_truth.execution_block_reason: Discovery layer is missing or unproven in Docker-contained scope, high-risk containers require manual review, and rollback/backup containers must be excluded before execution.

next_phase_needs: 435 must audit execution readiness for active Docker-scope candidates only.
435 must decide discovery layer status: dedicated Docker layer, merged runtime layer, or excluded from execution scope.
435 must exclude rollback and backup containers from active execution.
435 must review all high-risk containers before execution.
435 must produce exact active execution order.
435 must keep Device Layer control blocked.
435 must keep Telegram posting blocked until test-channel approval.
435 must keep image generation blocked until proof-safe lane approval.
435 must keep voice generation blocked until proof-safe lane approval.
